summary: Mako Mining Corp. filed a Form 6-K containing unaudited interim financial statements and MD&A for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026. The filing includes routine operating results, balance sheet, and notes, with a mention of the earlier acquisition of Mt. Hamilton LLC. No special-situation event such as a tender offer, spin-off, restructuring, or activist campaign is disclosed. The document is a standard quarterly reporting obligation for a foreign private issuer, and no imminent corporate action requiring special-situation classification is present.
